biography.currentRole: Businessman and Community Activist (per Ballotpedia and Politics1 candidate listings)
biography.background: Associated with Teenovel, a digital marketing / T-shirt design company based in the Atlanta metro area (ZoomInfo record). No prior elected office found. Described uniformly in aggregator sources as 'Businessman & Community Activist.'
biography.notes: ZoomInfo lists a Justin Pinker at teenovel.com in a T-shirt sales role; this is the most specific professional record found. Unverified whether this is the same individual. Age estimated ~27 based on one public records site, but not confirmed.

districtContext.electoralContext: 30th most Democratic district nationally per Ballotpedia. Incumbent Lucy McBath won 2024 general with approximately 74.7% of the vote. Republican general election prospects are minimal in this district.
districtContext.republicanPrimaryField: Pinker appears to be the sole declared Republican primary candidate based on Ballotpedia and Wikipedia candidate lists as of research date. Note: candidate lists may be incomplete before the qualifying deadline.

campaignWebsite.fetchMethod: Search engine snippets and aggregator summaries — direct page fetch unavailable in research environment

statedPositions.quote: Freedom is knowing our borders are secure.
statedPositions.notes: Pithy slogan-style statement; no specific policy detail (e.g., wall, deportation, DACA) specified in available snippets. Directionally clear: supports border enforcement.

statedPositions.quote: Freedom is having a job and a wage that allows you to prosper, own a home, feed a family and save for retirement.
statedPositions.notes: Aspirational framing only; no specific policy vehicle stated (e.g., minimum wage position, tax cuts, deregulation). Direction ambiguous — could support either market-based or government-supported wage growth framing.

statedPositions.quote: Freedom is taking your kids to a playground absent fear of harm, an altercation with a drug dealer, or caught in a turf war between drug gangs.
statedPositions.notes: Emphasizes crime and drug-related public safety concerns. Critique of incumbent framing suggests he views McBath's tenure as having worsened public safety. Direction: law enforcement / tough on crime lean. No explicit anti-reform or pro-reform policing position stated.

statedPositions.quote: Freedom is knowing that your child is mastering math, science, and reading rather than lectured on deviant subjects they are too young to understand.
statedPositions.notes: Use of 'deviant subjects' is signaling language consistent with opposition to gender/sexuality curriculum and critical race theory. Framing aligns with GOP parental rights / curriculum restriction movement of 2021-2026. No explicit stance on school choice vouchers vs. public school funding found.

statedPositions.quote: Freedom is having the right to say what you think absent fear that your keystrokes can land you on a government watchlist.
statedPositions.notes: Anti-surveillance / anti-censorship framing. Consistent with right-populist free speech concerns (social media moderation, government monitoring). No specific legislative position stated.

statedPositions.quote: During her time schools have become worse, streets more dangerous, and healthcare more expensive.
statedPositions.notes: Critique of incumbent framing; not a stated healthcare policy position. Implies concern about rising costs but offers no specific mechanism (e.g., ACA repeal, drug pricing, market competition). Insufficient to score any healthcare axis.

evidenceSummary.notes: Pinker is a first-time candidate with no prior legislative record. His campaign website uses slogan-style 'freedom' framing across five themes but provides no specific policy commitments on any of the 15 civic axes. No third-party scorecards apply (no prior record). No press interviews or news profile pieces found. ZoomInfo suggests a possible business background in digital marketing/T-shirt design (Teenovel), but this is unverified as referring to the candidate. The district's D+25 rating means this candidacy is largely symbolic; low media attention is expected for the challenger. Scorer should leave axes unscored where evidence is absent — do not infer neutral positions from silence.
